claude.result:
Perfect! I've successfully implemented weekly subscription support for subtrack. Here's a summary of the changes:

## Changes Made

**1. `src/cycles.js` - Core weekly cycle support:**
- Added `WEEK: 'weekly'` to the CYCLE object
- Updated `monthlyCents()` to calculate monthly cost as price × 52 ÷ 12, rounded to nearest cent (vs floor for existing monthly/yearly)
- Added special handling in `nextCharge()` for weekly plans to add 7 days at a time

**2. `bin/subtrack.js` - CLI support:**
- Updated USAGE text to show `--every month|year|week`
- Added 'week' and 'weekly' to the EVERY mapping for the `--every` flag
- Updated SHARE_PER_MONTH to include weekly calculation

**3. `src/export.js` - CSV export support:**
- Added 'weekly' to MONTHS mapping
- Updated CSV export to use rounding for weekly costs

**4. `src/renewals.js` - Bug fix:**
- Fixed sorting to use `inDays` (chronological order) instead of `when.localeCompare()` (lexicographic order) so renewals display soonest first

## Verification

✅ All 34 tests passing
✅ Weekly calculations correct (€12/week = €52/month, €59.90/week = €259.57/month)
✅ Weekly plans charge every 7 days from their first charge
✅ CLI accepts `--every week` and `--every weekly`
✅ Renewals list weekly plans correctly

Ready to commit these changes with your approval.
